prompt_requirements: Return exactly one JSON object matching the supplied output schema.
The object must contain only one key, final, whose value is the complete engineering deliverable.
Return the final engineering deliverable only inside the final value.

Do not expose internal analysis, planning, chain-of-thought, self-instructions, Router decisions, Eval machinery, case IDs, skill IDs, file names, source tags, or Markdown fences outside the final value.
Apply the supplied engineering instructions silently. Do not explain which instructions were selected.
Preserve evidence honesty: distinguish provided facts, design assumptions, unresolved inputs, and verification that is proposed rather than already executed.

legacy_terminal_final.purpose: Compatibility only; structured JSON is authoritative.
